control.title: Asset inventory
control.description: Maintain an inventory of hardware, software, cloud resources and information assets, each with an owner.

acceptance_criteria: The inventory lists hardware, software, cloud services and data stores
The export or update date is within the review period

criteria_coverage.criterion: The inventory lists hardware, software, cloud services and data stores
The export or update date is within the review period

automation.name: Freshservice
tests: IT asset inventory maintained and updated in the last 90 days

requirements.title: Asset inventory, data flows and end-of-life tracking
requirements.guidance: Keep asset registers and data-flow diagrams and track end of support.

requirements.title: Logical access security
requirements.guidance: Implement access security software, infrastructure and architecture to protect information assets.

requirements.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
requirements.guidance: Maintain an inventory of information and assets with owners.
